name: Tool calling eval v1
description: Runs all 80 items of eval-tools-v1 at temperature 0 and reports accuracy overall, by category and by difficulty. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v2 id.

eval.notes: Send meta.tools as the request's tools parameter with tool_choice='auto' and score tool_calls[0]. The 20 no_call items are correct only when no tool call is made at all.

notes: accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right.
